name: Yozuki no Chururira Sanctum Nox
original_name: 夜月のチュルリラ Sanctum Nox
source:
A short Christmas visual novel set after the events of the manga oneshot Yozuki no Chururira. Step into Reika’s mind as she navigates the strange, tender feelings stirred up by the mysterious church girl, Mashiro.

[From [url=https://studiosilverlace.itch.io/sanctumnox]itch.io[/url]]
